title: The leukemia study's depth settled
set_out: The leukemia study first, then the firm rate, then Met-A with the atlas as the ruler, then megakaryocytes and plasma, then replays if machines are free (author's order).

sections.heading: What ran, and how each came out

entries.title: A quarter of each run (GRP-020, DEV-ALL-INFO-01)
entries.what: The 10 samples already read at full depth read again from 5 of their 20 alignment chunks, through the one command.
entries.outcome: Not met: IAM-A read higher on every quarter, and the cord-blood controls lost their cell shares; the study stays at full depth.

entries.title: The graded maintenance test, the deep pair (PHY-006, DEV-ERASE-01)
entries.what: The deep control and the deep 2 uM sample, each aligned across 20 machines, read tile by tile by the one command's counter.
entries.outcome: Neither prediction: under the inhibitor the regions' holding energies converge toward one value (slope 0.26). The next test is the human degron series; IAM-A's baseline stays calibrated.

entries.title: The C-Score on 450K arrays (GRP-019, DEV-CSCORE-LIMIT-01)
entries.what: The 100 healthy bloods read again by the one command, with the neighbor correlation recorded.
entries.outcome: EPIC holds the derived limit; on 450K a small correlation between neighboring sites explains the excess. A per-sample term would be circular, so 450K gets a platform term measured once.

entries.title: Why two B and T atlas columns read low (GRP-019, DEV-METAA-ATLAS-CURVE-01)
entries.what: Each column's reading set beside what the atlas built it from.
entries.outcome: The two that read low carry the most sequencing samples; every column built from arrays reads 0.980 to 1.002.

entries.title: The degron series written (PHY-006, DEV-ERASE-01)
entries.what: HCT116 with UHRF1 or DNMT1 removed over days: the test written before any read is aligned; replicate 1 spent, replicates 2 and 3 reserved.
entries.outcome: Its first samples ran out of memory on four alignment threads; a one-chunk test on two threads is running.

entries.title: The 450K platform term on unread healthy bloods (GRP-019, DEV-CSCORE-LIMIT-01)
entries.what: The term measured once on spent healthy 450K bloods and frozen, then tested on healthy bloods never read before.
entries.outcome: Met: 52 of 57 sit within the 450K limit, against 22 within the plain limit; the reserved half confirms next.

entries.title: The degron libraries are PBAT (PHY-006, DEV-ERASE-01)
entries.what: The first degron samples ran out of memory; the series' own description shows PBAT libraries, which read the opposite strand.
entries.outcome: The aligner now takes PBAT mates in swapped order; one chunk aligned cleanly and read 70 % methylated, as expected for these cells.

entries.title: An early stop's explanation crashed (GRP-019)
entries.what: A message in the one command reused the name of the function that explains why a run stopped.
entries.outcome: Renamed; a stopped run now says why, and normal readings are unchanged.

open_at_turnover: Running on GitHub's machines: the leukemia study at full depth (20 of 36 read) and the degron series' memory test.
